Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the disturbance of salmon and steelhead spawning beds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disturbances of spawning beds; adding a newsection to chapter 77.95 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.95 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No person may, during the time periods identified by thecommission, lawfully engage in the following activities in rivers andstreams, as designated by the commission, where salmon or steelheadspawning occur: (a) Driving motor vehicles on spawning beds; (b) Using highpowered jet or propellerdriven boats acrossspawning beds; (c) Dragging anchors through spawning beds; and (d) Similar activities capable of disturbing spawning fish ordamaging or destroying nests of incubating eggs. (2) A violation of this section is a natural resource infractionunder chapter 7.84 RCW. (3) The commission shall adopt rules to carry out this section,including the time periods when the rules are in effect. p. 1 HB 2301 (4) The department shall: (a) Publish rules adopted by the commission under this section inbrochures that are disseminated to persons applying for fishing andboating licenses. The department must also distribute the brochureswidely to retail outlets that cater to outdoor recreation; (b) Work cooperatively with the tribal comanagers for all fishresources in implementing and enforcing the requirements of thissection; and (c) Report to the legislature concerning the effectiveness of thissection after at least two spawning cycles of salmon and steelhead haveoccurred.
